scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently --kill-others -n shared,api,web "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w backend
